entities.summary: Renée Lynn Fleming is an American soprano and actress, known for performances in opera, concerts, recordings, theater, film, and at major public occasions. A recipient of the National Medal of Arts, Fleming has been nominated for 18 Grammy Awards and has won five times. In December 2023, she was one of five recipients of the Kennedy Center Honors. Other notable honors have included the Crystal Award from the World Economic Forum in Davos, the Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur from the French government, Germany's Cross of the Order of Merit, Sweden's Polar Music Prize and honorary membership in England's Royal Academy of Music.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a renowned soprano and actress, Renée Fleming has had a significant impact on the opera and classical music industries, with numerous Grammy Awards and Kennedy Center Honors under her belt. Her performances have been widely acclaimed, contributing to the preservation of classical music and its cultural significance.
